text: dsh-plugin-guardian 是一款 DSH 插件，通过四个工具检查单个插件、扫描已安装 profile 中的冲突、将临时插件转为带来源标记的持久目录，并提供先审核后安装的流程。检查结果区分 confirmed、inferred 和 unknown；安装默认只审核，明确批准后才调用 DSH 安装命令。适合维护 DSH 插件目录和排查 profile 插件冲突的用户。使用需要 DSH 与 Node.js 20 或更高版本；审核 npm 规格时会查询 npm registry。

dsh-plugin-guardian inspects plugins, scans profile conflicts, promotes temporary plugins, and guides installation. It labels findings confirmed, inferred, or unknown. Installation audits first and runs only after approval. Requires DSH and Node.js 20+.

Help me scan my DSH profile for plugin conflicts.
dsh-plugin-guardian 的「插件体检」功能：检查单个插件的清单、DSH patch、入口和依赖，并返回分级结果。调用 plugin_doctor，传入目录或 npm/github 规格。
dsh-plugin-guardian 的「profile 冲突扫描」功能：扫描指定 profile 的重复工具名、重复插件和依赖版本差异。调用 plugin_profile_scan 并传入 profileDir，或使用默认目录。
dsh-plugin-guardian 的「插件转正与引导安装」功能：plugin_promote 检查后复制插件并写来源标记；plugin_install 默认只审核，approve=true 才调用 dsh plugin add。
dsh-plugin-guardian 使用前须知：审核 npm 规格会用 npm view 向 registry 查询该包的元数据；本地目录审核不会查询（见 src/install.ts:87-90）。

dsh-plugin-guardian README · dsh-plugin-guardian：> 5,905 plugins and counting. Some of them fight each other. Install a skin and another plugin silently breaks. Two plugins register the same tool name and the harness crashes at startup. Your agent writes a plugin in Creator mode and it vanishes on restart.
>
> **This plugin makes all of that visible — and fixable — before it bites you.**
dsh-plugin-guardian README · Why you need it：DeepSeek Harness is *"everything is a plugin"*, and the ecosystem exploded to thousands of plugins within a week. But nobody is keeping watch:

dsh-plugin-guardian README · Why you need it：| Pain | What actually happens | What guardian does |
|---|---|---|
| "I installed a skin and now X is broken" | Plugins silently collide | `plugin_profile_scan` finds tool-name collisions |
| Two plugins register the same tool | Harness crashes at startup (see [Pi #7696](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/7696)) | Conflict detected before you ship |
| "Is this random npm plugin safe?" | No trust system exists | `plugin_doctor` checks it, with honest confidence tiers |
| "The plugin my agent just wrote is gone" | Creator-mode plugins live only in memory | `plugin_promote` promotes it to durable disk |

dsh-plugin-guardian README · Four tools, one lifecycle：```
陌生/临时插件  →  plugin_doctor 体检  →  通过门禁  →  plugin_promote 转正  →  可信磁盘插件
                        │
                 plugin_profile_scan 扫已装集冲突
                        │

dsh-plugin-guardian README · Four tools, one lifecycle：| Tool | What it does | Analogy |
|---|---|---|
| `plugin_doctor` | Health-check a single plugin directory | 门诊 checkup |
| `plugin_profile_scan` | Scan the installed set for cross-plugin conflicts | 体检 center |
| `plugin_promote` | Turn an ephemeral plugin into a durable, versioned asset | 落户 registration |
| `plugin_install` | Guided install: audit first, then execute | 一键安装 one-click install |

dsh-plugin-guardian README · What makes it honest: three-tier confidence：Every finding is tagged with a confidence tier — borrowed from Pi's [`pi-extension-doctor`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/pi-extension-doctor):

| Tier | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `confirmed` | Provable from the files we read (e.g. a missing field) |
| `inferred` | A static pattern was seen — not proof of runtime behavior |
| `unknown` | A boundary (remote spec, unreadable file) blocked a conclusion |

No fake precision. A static scan result is labeled "inferred", never "definitely a bug".

target : /path/to/dsh-gh-cli

dsh-plugin-guardian README · Safety boundary：- `plugin_doctor` and `plugin_profile_scan` are **read-only**. They never install packages, execute source, spawn subprocesses, hit the network, or write a file.
- `plugin_promote` writes only to a managed staging directory (`$DSH_HOME/.guardian-plugins`) with a provenance marker (sha256 / promotedAt / source). It **never touches your live profile** unless you pass `register=true`.

dsh-plugin-guardian README · Tools：| Tool | Parameters | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `plugin_doctor` | `target` (path or `npm:`/`github:` spec), `format` (`text`/`json`) | Three-tier confidence report |
| `plugin_profile_scan` | `profileDir` (defaults to `$DSH_HOME/profiles/web`) | Finds tool-name collisions, dupes, version skew |
| `plugin_promote` | `source`, `register` (default false), `profile`, `outputDir` | Doctor-gated, atomic, provenance-marked |
| `plugin_install` | `spec`, `approve` (default false), `profile` | Audit-first guided install; `approve=true` runs `dsh plugin add` |

dsh-plugin-guardian README · FAQ：**Is this the same as `dsh-plugin-check`?** — Overlapping but different. `plugin-check` does 33 read-only checks on a single plugin. `guardian` adds three things it doesn't: **confidence tiers**, **cross-plugin conflict scanning**, and **promote (转正)** — the last of which is entirely absent from the ecosystem.

dsh-plugin-guardian README · FAQ：**Will `plugin_promote` modify my profile by surprise?** — No. It defaults to `register=false`; it only stages the plugin and prints the exact `dsh plugin add` command. You opt in to registration explicitly.

**What's the Pi reference?** — Pi's `pi-extension-doctor` established the `confirmed`/`inferred`/`unknown` confidence model and a strict read-only boundary. `guardian` applies the same discipline to DSH's much larger, messier ecosystem.
